import re

PAGE = re.compile(r"^IDCAMS\s+SYSTEM SERVICES\s+TIME:")
ENTRY = re.compile(r"^(?P<indent>\s{0,8})(?P<type>[A-Z]+) -+ (?P<name>\S+)\s*$")
TITLE = re.compile(r"^\s+(?P<title>[A-Z][A-Z-]*)\s*$")
PAIR = re.compile(r"^(?P<key>[A-Z][A-Z0-9/%]*(?:-[A-Z0-9/%]+)*)(?: ?-{2,} ?(?P<value>\S+)|:)$")
FLAGVAL = re.compile(r"^(?P<key>[A-Z][A-Z0-9]*)\((?P<value>[^()]*)\)$")
COUNTS = re.compile(r"^\s*THE NUMBER OF ENTRIES PROCESSED WAS:\s*$")
STAT = re.compile(r"^\s*THE NUMBER OF (?P<key>[A-Z][A-Z ]*?) WAS (?P<value>\d+)\s*$")
MSG = re.compile(r"^(?P<id>IDC\d{4}[A-Z]) (?P<text>\S.*?)\s*$")


def parse(lines):
    skip, cmd, cmd_lines = [], [], []
    entries, entry_lines = [], []
    attrs, attr_lines = [], []
    summary, sum_lines = {}, []
    msgs, msg_lines = [], []
    stack = []          # (indent, type, name) of the open entries
    section, sec_ind, pending, state = "", -1, None, "pre"
    for i, raw in enumerate(lines):
        if not raw.strip():
            continue
        ln = raw[1:] if raw[:1] in "01 -+" else raw   # drop the carriage-control column
        if not ln.strip() or PAGE.match(ln):
            skip.append(i)
            continue
        m = MSG.match(ln)
        if m:
            msgs.append({"Message": m.group("id"), "Text": m.group("text")})
            msg_lines.append(i)
            continue
        if COUNTS.match(ln):
            state, section = "summary", ""
            sum_lines.append(i)
            continue
        m = STAT.match(ln)
        if m:
            summary[m.group("key")] = m.group("value")
            sum_lines.append(i)
            continue
        m = ENTRY.match(ln)
        if m and state != "summary":
            ind = len(m.group("indent"))
            while stack and stack[-1][0] >= ind:
                stack.pop()
            parent = stack[-1][2] if stack else ""
            stack.append((ind, m.group("type"), m.group("name")))
            entries.append({"Type": m.group("type"), "Entry": m.group("name"),
                            "Parent": parent, "IN-CAT": ""})
            entry_lines.append(i)
            state, section, pending = "entry", "", None
            continue
        if state == "pre":
            cmd.append(ln.strip())
            cmd_lines.append(i)
            continue
        if state == "summary":
            m = PAIR.match(ln.strip())
            if m and m.group("value") is not None:
                summary[m.group("key")] = m.group("value")
                sum_lines.append(i)
            continue
        indent = len(ln) - len(ln.lstrip())
        m = TITLE.match(ln)
        if m:
            section, sec_ind, pending = m.group("title"), indent, None
            attr_lines.append(i)
            continue
        if indent <= sec_ind:          # back at the title's own indent: not under it any more
            section = ""
        etype, ename = stack[-1][1], stack[-1][2]
        flags, hit = [], False
        for cell in re.split(r"\s{2,}", ln.strip()):
            m = PAIR.match(cell)
            if m and m.group("value") is None:          # KEY: value is on the next line
                pending = m.group("key")
                hit = True
                continue
            if not m:
                m = FLAGVAL.match(cell)
            if m:
                hit = True
                if m.group("key") == "IN-CAT" and not section and entries:
                    entries[-1]["IN-CAT"] = m.group("value")
                    entry_lines.append(i)
                    continue
                attrs.append({"Type": etype, "Entry": ename, "Section": section,
                              "Key": m.group("key"), "Value": m.group("value")})
                attr_lines.append(i)
            elif pending:
                attrs.append({"Type": etype, "Entry": ename, "Section": section,
                              "Key": pending, "Value": cell})
                attr_lines.append(i)
                pending, hit = None, True
            else:
                flags.append(cell)
        if flags:
            attrs.append({"Type": etype, "Entry": ename, "Section": section,
                          "Key": "FLAGS", "Value": ",".join(flags)})
            attr_lines.append(i)
    blocks = []
    if cmd:
        blocks.append({"name": "command", "kind": "kv", "lines": cmd_lines,
                       "records": [{"command": " ".join(cmd)}]})
    blocks.append({"name": "entries", "kind": "table", "lines": entry_lines, "records": entries})
    blocks.append({"name": "attributes", "kind": "table", "lines": attr_lines, "records": attrs})
    blocks.append({"name": "summary", "kind": "kv", "lines": sum_lines, "records": [summary]})
    blocks.append({"name": "messages", "kind": "table", "lines": msg_lines, "records": msgs})
    return {"blocks": blocks, "skip": skip}
